summary: Iteration 19 - All QR code system and device copy enhancement features tested and PASSED. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (device_code generation, QR code PNG endpoint, search by code, device copy with new code/image/parts, create device with copy_from_device_id, service plan entry sorting). Frontend: All 4 features verified (QR code section with Geräte-Code label and Drucken button, device_code in table, search by code in device management and service plan).

device_code_generation.test: GET /api/devices returns device_code for each device
device_code_generation.result: All devices have unique 8-char uppercase alphanumeric device_code

qrcode_endpoint.result: Returns 200 with content-type image/png, valid PNG with proper magic bytes

search_by_code.result: Case-insensitive search works, returns 404 for invalid codes

device_copy_new_code.result: Copied device gets unique new device_code, different from source

device_copy_image_parts.result: image_gridfs_id and all parts copied to new device

create_with_copy_from.result: Image, parts, and documents all copied from source device

serviceplan_entry_sorting.result: Entries sorted by performed_at descending, consistent order

frontend_qr_section.test: Device edit modal shows QR code section
frontend_qr_section.result: QRCodeSVG rendered, 'Geräte-Code' label, code displayed (6ND3W3CT), 'Drucken' button present

frontend_device_code_in_table.test: Device table shows device_code under serial number
frontend_device_code_in_table.result: device_code displayed in 10px text below serial number

frontend_search_device_management.test: Search in device management finds devices by device_code

frontend_search_serviceplan.test: Search in service plan finds devices by device_code
frontend_search_serviceplan.result: Search for '6ND3W3CT' found 1 device in service plan

seed_data_creation: Used existing devices including KOPIE-XBAP2021 (device_code: 6ND3W3CT) with image, 2 parts, for testing. Copy operations created and cleaned up test devices.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 19 complete. All QR code and device copy features verified: (1) Every device has unique 8-char alphanumeric device_code, (2) GET /api/devices/{id}/qrcode returns PNG, (3) GET /api/devices/search/by-code/{code} works case-insensitively, (4) Device copy generates new code and copies image+parts, (5) Create with copy_from_device_id copies image+parts+docs, (6) Service plan entries sorted newest first, (7) Frontend QR section with QRCodeSVG, Geräte-Code label, Drucken button, (8) device_code shown in table below serial, (9) Search by code works in both device management and service plan. Test device KOPIE-XBAP2021 has code 6ND3W3CT.
